personality_one_liner: Rugged, high-contrast industrial utility built for sunlight, dirt, and sub-second field operation.

spacing.rule: Generous padding for glove-friendly use. Tight structural lines.

do's: Use 70-85% opaque surfaceInverse blocks for the AR HUD overlays instead of blur, ensuring high visibility over the camera feed without performance cost.
dont's: Do not use blur filters. Brutalist style demands sharp, clear, opaque, or flat-tinted semi-transparent boxes.

screens.name: Project Dashboard
screens.purpose: A rugged, scannable index of all active construction sites and their sync status.

states.loading: Mono-spaced skeleton blocks loading with hard borders.
states.empty: A large outlined construction cone icon and 'NO ACTIVE PROJECTS'.
states.error: Yellow warning block with 'SYNC FAILED. CHECK CONNECTION'.

screens.layout: Top toolbar with sync status. Card-based layout with thick borders. Each card has a drone-view photo placeholder, huge project title, location, and a pill showing 'Offline Cached' or 'Requires Sync'.

screens.name: AR Live View
screens.purpose: The core AR camera feed HUD overlaying building models over reality.

states.loading: Targeting reticle spinner in the center.
states.error: Red 'TRACKING LOST' banner floating at the top with 'Point at textured surface' helper text.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera feed. Screen-edge locked HUD. Top: Project/Location breadcrumb. Right side: Large, glove-friendly toggle column for Structural/MEP/Electrical layers. Bottom: Ghost-mode transparency slider (thick track) and a giant shutter button for capture.

screens.name: Issue Punch List
screens.purpose: High-speed field data entry for logging structural anomalies or RFIs.

states.empty: Large '+' icon and 'ALL CLEAR. NO PUNCH ITEMS.'

screens.layout: High-contrast list view. Each row shows issue ID (e.g., #104), status block (Red for Open, Green for Closed), and location. Tapping opens a full-screen form with outlined inputs, labels above, and huge 'Mark Resolved' or 'Add Photo' buttons pinned to the bottom.

dashboard_hero.alt: Drone shot capturing aerial view of a large construction site

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 5 Brutalist Mobile personality. Zero border radii. Structural thick borders (1pt-2pt).
Font weights should never exceed 500. Hierarchy is achieved through size, not weight.
No indigo, purple, or blue hues. Stick strictly to the monochrome + safety orange/yellow palette.
For the AR Live View, prioritize a transparent, lightweight HUD locked to the edges. Do not obscure the center of the camera view.
Ensure all touch targets are a minimum of 48px, ideally 64px on the AR and Punch List screens to accommodate users wearing gloves.
Do not use glassmorphism blur in this app. Use flat, semi-transparent overlays (e.g., surfaceInverse at 80% opacity) for HUD elements to maintain performance and the rugged aesthetic.
Forms must use outlined text fields with labels placed ABOVE the input, never floating inside.
Any CTA must be pinned to the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView, clear of the safe area.
